name: Sahlab
description: Thick milk drink set with orchid-root starch and dusted with cinnamon.

tcm.note: Warm milk with cinnamon; warming and moistening.

ayurveda.note: Ushna: the spices and the starch over a shita milk base.

unani.note: Garam-tar; a winter street drink of the Levant, held to be strengthening.
